definitions.note_verdict: A delivered note counts as mentioning a handoff only when the blinded verdict says so; notes without candidate wording were not read.
definitions.early_handoff: A successful transfer_to_human_agents call with no successful order or address mutation in the whole trajectory.
definitions.agent_initiated: An early handoff whose verdict is that the agent offered it first or called the tool before anyone mentioned it.
definitions.pairing: Runs pair inside one study, task and repeat. Differences are averaged per task, then per customer; the interval resamples customers 10,000 times.
definitions.selection: Post hoc classification of delivered note text; not a preregistered contrast.
definitions.source_tool_defect: The first-pass source episode contained a successful modify_pending_order_items call for two or more items; the pinned retail tool then returns the last item's price and options for every changed item.
